mechanism: Ethambutol may inhibit valproic acid metabolism and increase CNS toxicity risk; valproic acid may increase ethambutol neurotoxicity (optic neuritis, peripheral neuropathy).
action: Monitor for valproic acid toxicity signs (tremor, ataxia, confusion) and ethambutol neurotoxicity (vision changes, numbness); consider baseline and periodic ophthalmologic evaluation; monitor valproic acid levels.
